evals.expected_output: Without asking for parameters, the agent resumes from shared memory, selects a bounded deterministic batch, refreshes dossiers with source fingerprints, extracts procedures, validates freshness-gated retrieval, runs grounded evals, ships safe evidence-backed repairs, and reports the next batch.
expectations: Uses bin/learn-repos-inventory to discover actual repositories before pruning dependencies and compares exact repo-docs markers, revision tags, and source-fingerprint tags
Processes at most the default batch with disjoint parallel agents
Skips unchanged repositories instead of rereading the entire fleet
Stores both a repository dossier and reusable procedures with required metadata fields
Runs architecture, operations, and troubleshooting evals on every invocation
Evaluates demonstrated drift for healing without inventing repository work
Reports freshness-passing vs rejected-stale retrieval counts plus the next deterministic batch
Uses tag_match all on authoritative memory_search when combining repo, revision, and source-fingerprint tags

evals.prompt: /learn-repos when one selected repo is dirty and another had reflog activity today
evals.expected_output: The agent leaves both active repositories untouched, indexes their current local documentation read-only if selected, and only fast-forwards eligible inactive base branches.
expectations: Never mutates active repositories and keeps learning phases read-only
Skips pulling dirty repositories
Skips pulling repositories with reflog activity within 48 hours
Uses only git pull --ff-only for eligible clean tracked main or master branches

evals.prompt: /learn-repos with a procedure-poor enterprise plugin repository in the next batch
evals.expected_output: The agent extracts source-backed enterprise configuration procedures as part of the normal run, stores them with domain tags and fingerprints, and tests a realistic how-to question through the freshness gate.
expectations: Prefers specific runbooks and skills over placeholder README content
Stores question-shaped ordered procedures with prerequisites, failure modes, verification, source paths, revision, and source_fingerprint
Tags procedure memories with repo-procedure, domain tag, revision, and source-fingerprint
Validates that a hybrid search with tag_match all, include_superseded false, and current revision/fingerprint tags retrieves the procedure

evals.prompt: /learn-repos after the selected batch has been indexed
evals.expected_output: The agent always runs grounded memory-first evals through the freshness gate, independently verifies answers against current docs, corrects demonstrated gaps, and reruns failures.
expectations: Tests at least architecture, operations, and troubleshooting knowledge
Scores correctness, completeness, provenance, and usefulness from 1 to 5
Does not grade memory answers against memory itself
Stores corrected procedures only after current-document verification with updated fingerprint
Reruns failed evals and reports before-and-after scores

evals.prompt: /learn-repos when built-in memory MCP discovery is stale but the daemon can be repaired
evals.expected_output: The agent diagnoses the configured shared-memory endpoint, runs the bounded dotfiles and agentbrew repair ladder, retries discovery and protocol tools, and continues only against the same SQLite-backed MCP.
expectations: Verifies the shared memory endpoint before inventory or writes
Runs agentbrew memory doctor/fix/enable and synchronizes agentbrew before retrying
Allows direct Streamable HTTP only when the configured endpoint exposes all required tools
Does not create a second database, transcript archive, or ad hoc state file
Stops before scanning with exact diagnostics when the bounded retry still fails

evals.prompt: /learn-repos encounters duplicate sibling names and stale dossiers
evals.expected_output: The agent scopes reads and writes by exact relative path and revision/fingerprint, validates replacements before deleting old hashes, and never performs a broad concurrent delete.
expectations: Uses both repo-docs and exact repo path tags with tag_match=all
Uses unique path-revision-fingerprint conversation IDs for template siblings
Validates a replacement before deleting only the previous exact content hash
Never deletes by repo-docs alone or runs overlapping parallel deletion

evals.prompt: /learn-repos finds a reproduced stale runbook in an inactive user-owned tooling repository
evals.expected_output: The agent finishes read-only learning, verifies ownership and repository policy, applies one minimal source-backed repair, and uses /ship-it through PR, CI, merge, machine refresh, and re-indexing.
expectations: Activates ship-it only after memory validation and the healing eligibility gate
Checks status, reflog, ownership, CODEOWNERS, VISION or ROADMAP, and existing PRs
Requires a reproducible before and after check for a minimal logical repair
Runs verification, explicit-file commit, PR, substantive CI, allowed merge, and post-merge apply or sync
Re-indexes and validates the merged revision with a new source fingerprint instead of claiming an open PR is healed
Leaves generated mirrors and non-owned or active repositories read-only

evals.prompt: /learn-repos when indexed memory has an older git revision but higher semantic score than current docs
evals.expected_output: The agent rejects the stale-revision candidate, re-reads current documentation, re-indexes at the current revision and fingerprint, and only then answers or passes evals.
expectations: Requires memory_search with tag_match all, include_superseded false, and current revision and fingerprint tags
Discards stale-revision hits even when ranked first
Does not use exact mode or tag-only recall for authoritative answers
Reports rejected-stale count in the run summary

evals.prompt: /learn-repos when HEAD is unchanged but AGENTS.md and a runbook changed since last index
evals.expected_output: The agent detects fingerprint drift at the same revision, supersedes the dossier and affected procedures, and validates retrieval against the new source-fingerprint tag.
expectations: Computes source_fingerprint from the sorted source-document set
Treats fingerprint mismatch as stale even when revision tag matches HEAD
Writes replacement memories before deleting the prior exact content hash
Validates hybrid retrieval with tag_match all and the new source-fingerprint prefix

evals.prompt: /learn-repos after superseding a dossier with memory_update or a validated replacement
evals.expected_output: Freshness-gated search returns the current dossier only; superseded entries do not satisfy authoritative answers when include_superseded is false.
expectations: Uses include_superseded false and tag_match all for authoritative repository answers
Does not rely on exact mode to retrieve superseded content
Confirms the active dossier carries current revision and fingerprint tags

evals.prompt: /learn-repos answers a question about tooling/example-service while tooling/example-service-api is also indexed
evals.expected_output: Retrieval stays scoped to the exact repo tag; sibling-prefix repositories do not pollute answers or validation.
expectations: Uses exact repo:<relative-path> tag with tag_match all without prefix wildcarding
Includes a negative isolation check when sibling repo names share a prefix
Cites source_paths from the matching repository only

evals.prompt: /learn-repos produces an architecture answer from memory
evals.expected_output: The answer includes source_paths and git_revision from the winning freshness-passing memory or from live docs after re-indexing.
expectations: Treats missing source citation as a failed eval
Re-reads docs and stores a correction when citation is missing
Does not cite episodic or decision-layer notes as authoritative sources

evals.prompt: /learn-repos when freshness search returns zero candidates for a selected repo
evals.expected_output: The agent follows dead-end recovery: no exact or tag-only fallback, read current docs, store indexed memory, validate freshness retrieval, rerun the eval.
expectations: Does not fall back to exact mode, tag-only search, or tag_match any
Does not answer from superseded memories when include_superseded is false
Stores a new dossier or procedure with full metadata before claiming success

evals.prompt: /learn-repos when a high-quality stale procedure would answer faster than re-indexing
evals.expected_output: The agent still rejects the stale procedure, re-indexes at current revision and fingerprint, and demonstrates that quality cannot override freshness.
expectations: Rejects candidates missing current revision or source-fingerprint tags regardless of score
Reorders only among freshness-passing candidates
Documents the rejection in freshness-pass vs rejected-stale counts

evals.expected_output: Subagents only return source-backed extracts and canonical fingerprint output; the parent serializes all memory writes, supersession/deletion, validation, and the single session commit.
expectations: Subagents do not call memory_store, memory_update, memory_delete, or commit_session_legacy
The parent lists stale and current records with exact repo plus tier tags and tag_match all before superseding
The parent calls commit_session_legacy exactly once after all lanes finish

evals.prompt: /learn-repos when two agents would choose different source-document subsets for the same repository
evals.expected_output: Both use the canonical learn-repos-source-fingerprint helper, fully read every emitted source_path, and produce the same fingerprint and stored source_paths set.
expectations: Does not accept an agent-invented source-document list or partial fingerprint
Uses tracked and untracked non-ignored human-authored docs so same-revision edits are detected
Stores exactly the helper-emitted sorted source_paths
